connectorUiConfig.title: Dynatrace Audit Logs V3
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector uses the [Dynatrace DQL Storage Query API](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) to ingest tenant audit log events into Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

sampleQueries.query:
DynatraceAuditLogs
| where EventType == "CREATE"
| where Category == "TOKEN"
| take 10

DynatraceAuditLogsV3_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by event_id
| summarize count() by user
| sort by count_ desc
| take 10

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Dynatrace SaaS environment (ex. xyz.apps.dynatrace.com)
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace SaaS environment (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com). Classic Dynatrace environments (xxx.live.dynatrace.com) are not supported.

customs.name: Dynatrace Platform Token
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:system:read*** scopes. See [Dynatrace platform tokens](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens) for instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Dynatrace Audit Log Events to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Enable Dynatrace Audit [Logging](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/shortlink/audit-logs#enable-audit-logging). 
 1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read*** and ***storage:system:read*** scopes following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Use your Dynatrace SaaS environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***. Classic Dynatrace environments (***xxx.live.dynatrace.com***) are not supported.
